parts.text: At Ed Willkie, students 'Work the Willkie Way' by being Exceptional, Wise, Mindful, and Safe.
The Ed Willkie Middle School mascot is the Badger.
Ed Willkie offers athletics, fine arts like band, choir, theatre and visual arts, and clubs such as Student Council, National Junior Honor Society, Yearbook, Academic UIL and more.
What does a Cloud Architect do?
A simple, encouraging explanation: a Cloud Architect plans how apps, data, security and computers in the cloud fit together. Not presented as official school information.
The question goes from the web page to an AI agent, which looks up a saved copy of the school website, and the Gemini model writes a friendly answer.
